c.v: Here is a list of commands as an illustration of the use of CMD_REP.
Note each command is a nibble; in this example the bytewise command stream would be 0x0D 0x5E 0xCF.
This is what happens at every step:
TCK is clocked with the TDI and TMS lines set to 0.
TCK is clocked another (0 × 2 + 1) × (4^0) = 1 time with the same settings as step 1.
TCK is clocked with the TDI and TMS lines set to 0.
Data on the TDO line is captured.
TCK is clocked another (1 × 2 + 0) × (4^0) = 2 times with the same settings as step 3.
Note that this does increase cmd_rep_count for the next step.
TCK is clocked another (1 × 2 + 1) × (4^2) = 48 times with the same settings as step 3.
In other words: This example stream has the same net effect as command 1 twice, then repeating command 3 for 51 times.
